milestones.title: Extract the Universal Non-Welfare Schema
milestones.objective: Convert all non-welfare content in the GMD guidelines into structured variable drafts through deterministic Python orchestration, validators, and specialized agents and skills; welfare variables are out of scope, and remaining inexpensive governance questions such as basic versus tier and MOD-LBR are resolved through short interviews and documentation.

features.title: Document the schema approval from the 2026-07-29 GPID meeting
Inventory all non-welfare variables and classify structural fields
Define the deterministic extraction contract and source-citation requirements
Build extraction agents, skills, and Python orchestration
Extract all non-welfare variables into extraction/20_drafts/
Run structural validation after every extraction
Register the Non-Null Weight Invariant as a RULE-WGT-* rule artifact so IDN weight variables can reference it without breaking strict validation
Classify mineducatage as a variable to draft or a country parameter to register (currently an unregistered prerequisite reference in VAR-educat7)

Standardize the variable naming convention: document the mapping from GMD snake_case names to CVS variable_id (no underscores, per ^VAR-[a-z][a-z0-9]*$) and record each mapping in the inventory before drafting

milestones.title: Build the Human Review Application
milestones.objective: Provide a safe, simple Shiny interface deployed privately to Posit Connect before asking humans to review extracted content, in parallel with bulk extraction; GPID team approval is sufficient and authoritative through GitHub pull requests.

features.title: Define the versioned review states and manifest
Build a private Shiny app for Posit Connect
Show extracted YAML and guideline evidence as read-only context
Allow editing only of the human Markdown section
Add save-draft and submit-for-GPID-review actions
Record reviewer identity, review round, timestamps, and content hashes
Create review branches and pull requests through a narrowly scoped GitHub App
Configure the real GPID CODEOWNERS team and branch protection

milestones.title: Establish Independent Agent Review
milestones.objective: Review every extraction independently before relying on its content.

features.title: Build a source-grounding review agent and skill
Build a schema-compliance review agent and skill
Build a rules and caveats completeness agent and skill
Build a cross-variable consistency and derivation review agent
Add deterministic routing, failure states, and audit records

milestones.title: Calibrate Human Review
milestones.objective: Test the complete workflow on a representative sample before scaling it.

features.title: Select five to ten variables across complexity levels
Review and enrich their Markdown through the Shiny app
Measure extraction and agent-review errors
Simplify the interface based on reviewer experience
Finalize the review rubric and acceptance criteria

milestones.title: Reconcile and Complete Universal Records
milestones.objective: Convert GPID-approved human documentation into validated structured records.

milestones.title: Populate the Country Parameter Layer
milestones.objective: Add governed country-specific values and exceptions after the universal schema is stable, using Country Parameter Layer and country-parameters terminology throughout.
